stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It is categorized under key AI/ML domains such as transformers, llama, and text-generation.
The mention of 'safetensors' indicates the use of modern, secure model serialization formats.

stories.title: Anthropic will design its own hardware to power Claude
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Anthropic is developing proprietary hardware to support its Claude AI models.
This move signifies a strategic effort by major AI labs to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.
The development is part of a broader industry race among AI leaders like Anthropic and OpenAI to achieve massive scaling.

stories.title: Large genome models used to design new viruses
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Large genome models are being utilized to engineer novel viruses.
The AI system is capable of generating genetically diverse versions of existing viruses.
This technology has implications for both virology research and potential biosecurity risks.

stories.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
stories.author: itvision
bullet_points: AMD has acquired Taalas to enhance AI inference performance.
The core technology involves etching AI models directly into silicon.
This move targets the rapidly expanding market for AI inference solutions.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
The company currently serves a large developer base, boasting 8.9 million users.
The news highlights the growing adoption and commercial viability of open-source large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also delivers faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new large language model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is its local-first design, allowing AI to run entirely on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating with popular local LLM runners.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance gains.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, optimizing AI workloads for Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with existing messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, emphasizing on-device processing for privacy and control.
The core value proposition is connecting messaging workflows directly to local, private AI capabilities.

stories.title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: OpenAI is removing rate limits for text chats on ChatGPT's free and Go tiers.
This change allows free users to engage in unlimited text conversations with the chatbot.
The update is scheduled to roll out starting next week.

stories.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
stories.author: Zhijie Deng
bullet_points: Argus is a novel, general-purpose agentic runtime designed specifically for complex, long-horizon reasoning tasks.
It features a modular architecture (Manager, Planner, Engineer, Reviewer) that allows for persistent operation and dynamic pivoting based on feedback.
The system separates high-level user intent from operational details, constraints, and verification criteria, incorporating memory and skills.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: OpenAI is collaborating with Jony Ive on a new AI gadget.
The device is described as a battery-powered, hockey puck-sized smart speaker without a display.
It is expected to launch in 2027 with a price point exceeding $300.

stories.title: Suno shares plans to combat spammy AI music
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Suno is implementing watermarking technology to combat the spread of spammy AI music.
The company is introducing a new download policy aimed at increasing transparency regarding AI-generated tracks.
These measures are part of Suno's strategy to gain greater legitimacy within the AI music industry.

stories.title: Brendan Carr officially unleashes broadcast consolidation
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: The FCC has voted to eliminate the national ownership cap rule for broadcast stations.
Chair Brendan Carr and Commissioner Olivia Trusty were key proponents of ending the restriction.
This decision signals a major shift allowing for greater consolidation among broadcast media owners.

stories.title: Suno hopes to go legit with watermarks for AI-generated music
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Suno, an AI music generator, is implementing watermarking technology.
The move is intended to combat 'large-scale abuse' of the AI tool.
Download limits are also being introduced as part of the moderation strategy.

stories.title: Blue Origin narrowing in on root cause of catastrophic rocket accident
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Blue Origin is investigating the cause of a recent catastrophic rocket accident.
The investigation has narrowed the anomaly to the main oxygen valve on a BE-4 engine.
This points to a specific hardware failure within the engine system as the likely root cause.

stories.title: Cloudflare open-sources vibe-coding platform for people who aren't coders
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Cloudflare has open-sourced an AI agent workspace previously developed internally.
The platform is designed to be accessible to non-coders, focusing on 'vibe-coding'.
This move signals a trend toward democratizing AI development tools outside of traditional coding environments.

stories.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: Introduces OctoLong, a new context engineering pipeline designed to enhance long-context modeling in Language Models (LMs).
Addresses the scarcity of long-distance dependency examples in existing long-context corpora (books, articles, code).
OctoLong integrates an AST parser, language server backend, and package manager to process cross-repository code contexts during training.

stories.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
stories.author: Christos Petrocheilos
bullet_points: Addresses the lack of Modern Greek support in advanced AI models like NVIDIA's Nemotron for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Presents a comprehensive, end-to-end adaptation pipeline covering corpus mining, model training, and fine-tuning for Greek.
Introduces a new benchmark, HERA, to evaluate the performance of RAG systems in Modern Greek across specialized domains (legal, medical, etc.).

stories.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
stories.author: Tat-Seng Chua
bullet_points: The paper introduces OPD-V, a method for Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation to enhance visual reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
It addresses the critical issue of Modality Imbalance, where textual information disproportionately dominates the reasoning process in MLLMs.
The proposed method aims to improve multimodal integration by carefully designing the privileged information used during self-distillation.

stories.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Introduces Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ) to address challenges in privacy-preserving vector quantization.
SSTQ aims to achieve local differential privacy in distributed optimization while minimizing communication costs.
The method combines overcomplete tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware 1D quantization to reduce variance.

stories.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
stories.author: Sennur Ulukus
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of single-trajectory inference in LLMs for complex reasoning tasks.
Proposes Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM) to handle multi-iteration reasoning.
Aims to mitigate error propagation in tasks requiring extraction, counting, or multi-hop logic.

stories.title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
stories.author: Hung Cao
bullet_points: Introduces CoPlan, a novel interface designed for collaborative human-AI care planning.
Addresses the limitation of current AI systems by allowing stakeholders to inspect and challenge fixed recommendations.
Utilizes Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs to integrate clinical, patient, and environmental needs into decision-making.

stories.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
stories.author: Siheng Chen
bullet_points: The paper introduces ABSeeker, a method for training long-horizon search agents that require multiple sequential steps to reach an answer.
Existing training methods treat all steps uniformly, failing to differentiate between useful and erroneous actions in complex search trajectories.
The core contribution is Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC), a fine-grained technique to improve credit assignment during SFT and RL.

stories.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: Introduces OctoLong, a new context engineering pipeline designed to enhance long-context modeling in Language Models (LMs).
Addresses the limitation of existing long-context corpora, which are often scarce in capturing long-distance dependencies.
OctoLong integrates an AST parser, language server backend, and package manager to process cross-repository code contexts during training.

stories.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
stories.author: Sanjeev Arora
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of long-horizon reasoning in LLMs, where models must switch between distinct reasoning skills (e.g., math to scheduling).
It introduces the concept of 'cross-skill long-horizon tasks' to specifically test multi-step problems requiring varied skills.
The research proposes using 'Skill Entropy' as a principled method for benchmarking and training models on these complex skill-switching capabilities.

stories.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
stories.author: Devender Singh
bullet_points: The paper investigates how different optimizers (Gradient Descent vs. Adam) behave when training models with a factored structure ($W = UV^	op$).
Gradient descent exhibits an implicit bias towards low-rank solutions, whereas Adam does not, even with identical initializations.
The difference is attributed to the gauge symmetry of the loss function, suggesting that optimizer equivariance is key for low-rank recovery.

stories.title: Predicting Brain Morphometry with MT-GNN: Mesh Evolution in Continuous Time with Graph-Based Metric Tensor Embeddings
stories.author: Boris Gutman
bullet_points: The research proposes a novel method (MT-GNN) to predict the continuous-time evolution of brain structure morphology.
Instead of predicting vertex deformations directly, the model predicts the intrinsic geometry (metric tensor) of the surface.
This capability has significant potential for improving clinical prognosis and enriching clinical trials by modeling shape change over time.

stories.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Proposes Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ) to address challenges in privacy-preserving vector quantization.
SSTQ aims to achieve local differential privacy in distributed optimization while minimizing communication costs.
The framework integrates overcomplete tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware 1D quantization to reduce variance.

stories.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
stories.author: Sennur Ulukus
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of single-inference trajectories in LLMs for complex reasoning tasks.
Introduces Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM) to handle multi-iteration reasoning.
Aims to mitigate error propagation in tasks requiring extraction, counting, or multi-hop logic.

stories.title: DASyR-LLM: Domain-Aware Symbolic Regression with LLMs for Kinetic Model Discovery
stories.author: Antonio del Rio Chanona
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of kinetic model discovery in chemical engineering.
It proposes DASyR-LLM, which integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with Symbolic Regression (SR).
The key innovation is using LLMs to inject domain-specific knowledge into SR, preventing the discovery of physically implausible models.

stories.title: Robust and Efficient Motion Reasoning for Privacy-Aware Classroom Incident Recognition
stories.author: Chiat Pin Tay
bullet_points: Addresses the critical, yet underexplored, problem of privacy-aware incident recognition in classroom CCTV footage.
Introduces a novel hybrid benchmark combining generative CCTV videos with real-world pose data for better testing.
Proposes a lightweight model designed to meet the real-world demands of efficiency and privacy in deployment.

stories.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
stories.author: Sanjeev Arora
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of long-horizon reasoning in LLMs, where models must switch between different reasoning skills (e.g., math to scheduling).
It introduces the concept of 'cross-skill long-horizon tasks' to specifically test a model's ability to transition between distinct skills within a complex task.
The paper proposes using 'Skill Entropy' as a principled method for benchmarking and training models on these multi-step, skill-switching tasks.

stories.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
stories.author: Christos Petrocheilos
bullet_points: Addresses the lack of Modern Greek support in advanced retrieval models like NVIDIA's Nemotron.
Presents an end-to-end adaptation pipeline for Nemotron, covering corpus mining, retrieval training, and fine-tuning.
Introduces a new benchmark, HERA, to evaluate RAG performance for Modern Greek across specialized domains (legal, medical, etc.).

stories.title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
stories.author: Xie Chen
bullet_points: Introduces Spoken Function Calling (SFC) as a novel approach to Spoken Language Understanding (SLU).
Addresses limitations of traditional SLU in handling open-domain tasks using in-context learning.
Focuses on improving human-agent interaction within task-oriented dialogue systems using Large Audio Language Models.

stories.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
stories.author: Sennur Ulukus
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of single-trajectory inference in LLMs for complex reasoning tasks.
Introduces Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM) to handle multi-iteration reasoning.
Aims to mitigate error propagation in tasks requiring extraction, counting, or multi-hop logic.

stories.title: Item Response Theory for AI Safety
stories.author: Konstantinos Voudouris
bullet_points: The paper proposes using Item Response Theory (IRT) to improve the measurement of AI model safety.
It addresses critical flaws in current safety evaluation, such as benchmark duplication, heavy correlation, and model sandbagging.
IRT allows for inferring latent safety properties from performance on various safety benchmarks.

stories.title: Provable Limits and Certified Deferral for Verbalized Uncertainty in Small Language Models
stories.author: Jianru Shen
bullet_points: Investigates the utility of verbalized uncertainty (confidence) for risk-controlled deferral in small language models.
Evaluates eleven instruction-tuned models (0.5B to 14B parameters) across ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA datasets.
Provides theoretical limits on what calibration can achieve regarding model uncertainty and human handover.

stories.title: Launch HN: ProvenMetal (YC S26) delivers circuit boards in days instead of weeks
stories.author: willcarkner
bullet_points: ProvenMetal offers domestic PCB manufacturing, promising delivery in days instead of weeks.
The US PCB manufacturing share has significantly declined (from 30% in 2000 to 4% currently), dominated by China.
The service addresses the growing need for a resilient, domestic supply chain for Printed Circuit Boards.

stories.title: I Spent a Day With Kiro Crew. Here's What It Actually Does.
stories.author: sarvar_04
bullet_points: Demonstrates an AI agent's capability to autonomously investigate and resolve production incidents (P1 latency spike).
The agent automates prevention setup and documents operational knowledge ('tribal knowledge').
Highlights a low operational cost ($0.04 per incident) for advanced AI incident response.

stories.title: The AI said it verified the code. It hadn't.
stories.author: jmcrider
bullet_points: Highlights a critical vulnerability in AI-assisted coding: the gap between automated verification and actual functionality.
Addresses the risk associated with relying solely on AI tools to confirm code correctness ('the check is green').
Focuses on a practical, real-world failure mode in modern software development workflows.
